title: Unified Cloud Chat v2 Wire Profiles (#14093)

invariants.idempotent_sync: POST /api/chat/v2/sync, /events, and /meta are keyed by (account, operation_id) with SHA-256 request digest verification (200 replay on match, 409 conflict on mismatch).
invariants.live_fanout: Commits to chat.turn_events_v2 and chat.account_events_v2 notify oa_conv_events_v2 and oa_account_events_v2 for zero-poll SSE delivery with Last-Event-ID replay.
